profile.summary: Be GLAD is a company that provides professional development training for K-12 teachers and schools. Its training focuses on language acquisition and literacy, and on supporting English language learners, using the Project GLAD (Guided Language Acquisition Design) model. It offers online training programs for elementary, secondary, Spanish/dual language and pre-K educators.
